name: openos
description: OpenOS — Generate Everything, Create Infinite. AI desktop OS shell that generates apps on demand (Electron + TypeScript).

scripts.dev:web-stack: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @openos/shared && npm run build -w @openos/server && npm run build -w @openos/web && npm run build -w @openos/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/launch-desktop-dev.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @openos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @openos/server && npm run typecheck -w @openos/web && npm run typecheck -w @openos/desktop
